title: The TV Wall Fell Silent for the Kid Who Needed It Most | vitalii.no
description:
One kid in this family can go a whole school term without ever earning TV time — and the teaching wall was his only lesson.

Until this change, three of the wall's four subjects — grammar, Norwegian and English — were built entirely from that same child's own finished homework days. Only math and early letters already read from the current curriculum unit. So the wall fell silent for exactly the child it existed to teach: no finished homework, no material.

A single curriculum lookup now returns the whole unit block — current, previous and next — for a child's grade and school week, and every subject builder reads from it instead of history. Grammar review also changed from a copy of the child's own missed sentences into a fair A/B quiz on the week's rule, with the correct side decided by a hash of the sentence text rather than position, so the answer can't be guessed from habit.

All four subjects on the wall now teach from that same weekly plan, even for the child who never turns the TV on.
